colecao: Especiais de Alis e Guardiões de Algol
origem: Ilustrações novas produzidas com ImageGen. A história, o equipamento e os personagens de Phantasy Star orientam os desenhos.

arquivos.prompt: Create a production Sega Master System Phantasy Star I fan-game cutscene master sheet, SIX equal rectangular 2:1 wide illustrations arranged precisely in TWO columns and THREE rows, edge-to-edge, entire resulting page landscape 4:3. Each cell independently letterbox ready. No text anywhere, no captions, no gutters, no outlines around panels. Vintage expressive 1980s Japanese science-fantasy anime key animation rendered as clean hand-placed low resolution pixel clusters, dramatic composition, very restricted saturated SMS colors, deep navy negative space. Original Phantasy Star I character identities: Alis Landale, brown long hair and pink armor, blue short tunic, sword and round shield. TOP LEFT Alis drawn in powerful profile close-up, hand gripping sword, pink shoulder armor; TOP RIGHT muscular blond short-haired fighter Odin wearing green armor, firing his sci-fi raygun to the right, unmistakable striped laser; MIDDLE LEFT Noah/Lutz with pale blue long hair in white and blue wizard robes, violet-gold forked thunder bursting from staff, dynamic side portrait; MIDDLE RIGHT Myau, distinctly a tawny golden cat with very long pointed ears and a blue necklace vial, biting a single golden Laerma nut in foreground and silhouette of wings unfurling behind; BOTTOM LEFT transformed majestic white-feather-winged golden feline Myau with the cat face, long ears, all four paws and tail, swooping diagonally through speed lines; BOTTOM RIGHT Alis in pink armor delivering a diagonally rising critical Laconian sword strike through a dark silhouette of a rival swordswoman. Anamorphic foreshortening, varied silhouettes and composition, sparse detail for faithful 192x96 conversion. NO words, bullets, logos, title, or watermarks.

Sega Master System 8-bit pixel sprite master atlas. EXACTLY 3 columns and 3 rows of equal square cells, transparent alpha background. One separate centered isolated sprite in each cell with a large transparent moat. Consistent handdrawn early Phantasy Star RPG sprites, designed to reduce to 8 or 16 pixels, use simple chunky contiguous high-contrast clusters. FIRST ROW left: a bright orange and red fiery comet with a white core shooting to the RIGHT, center: a tall cyan-blue crescent horizontal sword energy wave heading RIGHT, right: one luminous upright cyan saber slash climbing diagonally right. SECOND ROW left: Myau a golden long-eared cat with four paws and blue vial collar facing RIGHT biting a golden nut; center: same cat with huge white FEATHERED WINGS flying toward RIGHT, readable face pointed to the right and extended paws; right: golden winged Myau dives down-right forepaws forward. THIRD ROW left: small mint-green healing spark cluster in shape of a plus; center: a constellation of three golden dizzy stars in a circular orbit over a missing character's head; right: mirror shield glint, round blue oval with a sharp white starburst at upper right. No letters, words, grid, shadows, outlines of cells, UI labels or key legends. All nine cells each same size; no overlapping items.

arquivos.origem: ImageGen, edição da prancha guardioes.png que o proprietário anexou novamente em 26/11
arquivos.direcao: Seis elementos individuais em RGBA. Reação de Alis, reação de Hayato, corte diagonal rosa, asas semiflexionadas de Myau, clarão do cano e brilho da espada. Sem atacante e defensor na mesma célula.

audio.uso: Ataque dos Guardiões de Algol, close de Alis
audio.efeitos: Gestos, cura e voo em PSGlib. Composição original e cues do próprio capítulo.
